name: Sid Jacobson JCC Mah Jongg
description: Sid Jacobson JCC (East Hills, Long Island) runs 8-week Mah Jongg courses. Its own page says: "This eight-week course introduces beginners to Mah Jongg using official National Mah Jongg League rules" and "The 2026 National Mah Jongg League card ($15) must be purchased at the first class." Also offers a Thursday Mah Jongg Clinic for experienced players (drop-in possible). Fall 2026 sessions (Oct 13-Dec 14) already started; Tuesday class listed as full.
schedule: Fall 2026: Beginner Tue 7-9:30pm (Oct 13-Dec 8); Beginner Thu 4-6:30pm and Clinic Thu 10am-12:30pm (Oct 15-Dec 10); Beginner Mon 10am-12:30pm (Oct 19-Dec 14). Members $225 / nonmembers $300 per 8-week course.

name: Congregation Rodeph Sholom Mah Jongg
description: Congregation Rodeph Sholom (Upper West Side) offers Mah Jongg classes. Its own event page says: "an introduction to American-style Mah Jongg for the brand-new player or those looking for a refresher." Taught by congregation members on the CRS Mah Jongg Advisory Council; 3 consecutive class days plus a game day; capped at 8 people.
schedule: Free for CRS members; $154 for non-members (2026 page: includes Mah Jongg card). Class days Mon-Wed, alternating 6:30-8:30pm and 10am-12pm. Registration via SimpleTix.

name: 14th Street Y Mah Jongg (14Y/MCC)
description: 14Y (344 E 14th St) offers a 5-session Mah Jongg instructional class (instructor Janet Heller) and a Mah Jongg Club open play (Wednesdays 6:30-8:30pm in an earlier listing). Search-result snippet of the 14Y/amNY class listing says a National Mah Jongg League card must be purchased. The 14Y pages themselves could not be opened, so the style is unconfirmed on the organizer's own page and current dates are unknown.
schedule: Class series $50 members / $75 others (older listing); open play free for members, $25 non-members (older listing). Current schedule unverified.

name: Lewis JCC (JCC Rockland) Mah Jongg
description: Lewis JCC (formerly JCC Rockland) in West Nyack lists Mahjong classes and daily open play. Its page does not say American or NMJL, so the style is unconfirmed.
address: 450 West Nyack Road, West Nyack, NY 10994
schedule: Beginner Mahjong Thu 10am-12pm (Nov 5-Dec 17, $160 members/$175 public); Adv. Beginner Mon 6:30-8:30pm (Nov 2-Nov 30); open play Mon-Fri 12-4pm free for members.
